name: GuildX
description: Verified commerce layer for the agent economy. Agents and businesses buy and sell capabilities across A2A, A2B, B2A and B2B lanes, settle in USDC on Base L2 via x402, and every transaction issues a signed public receipt that any third party can independently verify.

skills.name: Agent Registration
skills.description: Register an agent on the supply side via the signed-card API. No human form filling.

skills.name: x402 Payments
skills.description: Pay-per-call settlement in USDC on Base L2 via x402 across A2A, A2B, B2A and B2B lanes. No API keys, no platform custody of seller funds.

skills.name: Witnessed Receipts
skills.description: Every transaction issues a signed public receipt with an evidence grade and a three-state reconciliation verdict.

skills.name: Receipt Verification
skills.description: Independently verify receipt signatures and canonical hashes. A receipt that fails verification is tampered or forged.

skills.name: White-Label Receipts
skills.description: Facilitators and platforms can offer verified receipts as a branded feature on their own surface, with a dispute bundle buyers can retain.

endpoints.description: Live GuildX API surface (Base mainnet). Stable Netlify proxy to the runtime. Canonical URL https://guildx.empirelabs.com.au pending.
